end.parentNote: Asha practised using groups to estimate a collection instead of counting each item. Ananya identified about four groups and connected 40 and 43 as close estimates. They mixed up spread and quantity at first, but later said the amount stays the same even when items are spread out. At home, place small objects in two arrangements and ask, “Which has more, or are they the same?” before counting to check.
